column1: # data area: capellactl → cbctl port-map updates (see .porttmp/WORKSTREAM.md)

column4: apply exits 4 with the ! BLOCKED (immutable) line for type, storageBackend, vbuckets, bucketConflictResolution and evictionPolicy, zero writes
plan shows the rebalance note and replicas 1 → 2
bucket add of a bucket in the file but not in Capella records the given flags, creates it (one POST, storageBackend couchstore) and plans clean
list header/row and get (settings, item count), unknown name exits 3 (cbctl's not-found code), zero writes; cbctl's table has no S.NO/ITEMS/IN FILE columns (migration guide)
typed-name confirmation lists orders_app and reporting_ro (not events_app) under These credentials lose access to this bucket:
declarative apply on a single-node cluster: plan summary 0 replicas, no note, POST replicas 0; replicas 1 there and replicas 0 on multi-node exit 3 with both messages
managed bucket add on a synced free-tier cluster: plan free tier · 100 MB, one POST buckets/freeTier with name+memory, recorded in capella.yaml, apply rerun No changes
bucket update with no flags on a terminal asks Memory (MB) only on the free tier (implemented), records 200 and sends one PUT
list uses buckets/freeTier; delete prints orders · 7 items · 12 MB used and DELETEs buckets/freeTier/b3JkZXJz
sync of a free-tier cluster writes its bucket (name, memory) and plan --detailed-exitcode exits 0
plan summary line, one POST /users with name, access and the ${VAR} password, no secret in output
plan read → read+write line; one PUT /users/ID with access only (no password) and If-Match
plan and apply exit 4 with the ! advanced credential line, zero user writes
write order buckets, scopes, collections, collections, users
rerun with a changed password env value: No changes, zero writes, plan --detailed-exitcode 0
credential with no access in Capella plans an update (not advanced), apply PUTs the access, rerun No changes
sync --full --force lists the access-less credential as a comment with a working create hint (now includes --privileges); validate passes
sync warns has no access in Capella; capella.yaml keeps the access it had → Run apply; access and ${AIRLINE_PW} kept; validate passes
list text (NAME ID ACCESS; cbctl has no S.NO/TYPE/IN FILE columns, see migration guide) and JSON names, advanced credential listed, no password
get shows id, name and access, points at the local secret file (implemented: generated password saved in), no secret; unknown exits 3 (cbctl's not-found code)

managed create of a name in capella.yaml with other access exits 4; no bucket exits 3 with the least-privilege hint; an existing Capella credential with the same access is adopted into the file with zero writes
managed create records name, ${ORDERS_APP_PASSWORD} and access; the only write is one POST /users with access and password; no secret in output or file
update with resources only on several grants exits 3 has several access grants (implemented), no option exits 3 nothing to update, unknown name exits 3 is not in capella.yaml, zero writes
create and update with --no-apply print Not applied (--no-apply), update keeps the file privileges when only resources are given, zero writes
managed create then plan --detailed-exitcode 0 and apply No changes with zero writes (fake)
credential delete keeps the secret file and prints local secret file kept: ... (delete it if no longer needed)
second managed delete prints not found, nothing to do, exit 0, zero writes
one POST clusters/freeTier with name and cloudProvider only, healthy, recorded with tier: free, plan --detailed-exitcode 0 with zero writes
wizard asks Cluster type (free, provisioned) [provisioned] (implemented) and the free-tier regions, no size or plan; records gcp us-central1. cbctl runs the wizard when the name is missing
--free-tier while the org has one exits 4 the free tier is already used by ... (implemented, before any write); the wizard does not offer it
sync writes id, name, tier: free and cloudProvider; plan --detailed-exitcode 0; sync --dry-run exit 0 (in sync); zero writes
exact visible verb set per group from -h (cbctl: add plus the create spelling for buckets/scopes/collections, exists for scope/collection; no apply)
--project CLUSTER on cluster create exits 3 is a cluster in project nova-dev, not a project → Did you mean: --project nova-dev (implemented), zero writes
project update/get with a cluster name exit 3 with the Did you mean hint (implemented in managed and direct lookup); file unchanged, zero writes; unknown project suggests sync --project NAME
managed update writes the description, one PUT of the project only, project get shows the new value
managed update --rotate-password PUTs the ${VAR} password with the access and If-Match, prints password rotated, no secret in output
a 400 on the rotation PUT exits 1, restores the old secret file and leaves no .bak (implemented)
generated password sent and saved, .bak holds the old one, both 0600, rotated and saved-to messages, no secret in output
changing only the password env values: zero writes and at most one passwords-not-compared note
apply --rotate-passwords lists three credentials, confirmed PUTs carry each password with access; --target credential/C/N rotates only that one
update --rotate-password of a declared credential absent in Capella POSTs it with the configured password
a wrong typed name cancels with no writes; no terminal and no -y exits 4 (cbctl) naming -y
removed from the file: apply writes nothing and plan lists it Unmanaged; apply --prune with the typed name deletes only that collection
apply --prune confirmation lists refunds_app under These credentials lose access to this collection:
deleting a missing collection and scope prints not found, nothing to do, exit 0, zero writes
typed confirmation shows billing · 2 collections: invoices, refunds; one DELETE of the scope; scope removed from capella.yaml
apply --prune: a wrong name cancels with no writes; the right name deletes the scope (one DELETE) after listing its collections
collection delete lists billing_app only; scope delete lists billing_app, billing_ro, refunds_app (not inventory_app); declined, zero writes
managed collection add to a new scope declares the scope too (implemented), POSTs scope then collection with maxTTL; re-add is already exists (cbctl's documented exit 0); list shows maxTTL
plan ~ line with maxTTL, one PUT with body {maxTTL: -1} and If-Match, converges
declarative apply with a 412 on the collection PUT re-reads and retries once (2 PUTs), converges
apply exits 4 with the ! maxTTL ... 7.6.0 or later (nova-dev-01 runs 7.2.4) line, zero writes
on 7.2.4 a new collection is created with maxTTL -1 and the plan converges
managed scope add on a bucket missing from the file exits 3 bucket orders is not in capella.yaml, zero writes
managed scope add records the scope, one POST; second add already exists with zero writes; scope list shows it (cbctl has no IN FILE column, see migration guide)
scope add _default is already exists (cbctl: system scopes always exist, exit 0); collection add of _default._default exits 3; zero writes
plan lines, every scope then every collection, POST bodies with maxTTL only when set
plan (after bucket/scope is created) notes and write order buckets, scopes x2, collections x3; converges
undeclared scope/collection listed Unmanaged, system scopes not shown; --prune deletes only those two
apply write order scopes, collections, collections, users
credential, credential create and credential update --help list the password rules
CLUSTER.NAME.json filename, JSON keys cluster/createdAt/id/name/password, file 0600, dir 0700, password registered for redaction
update body overlays desired values; flush becomes flushEnabled; priority/durability/ttl kept; id/name/type/stats dropped
BucketCreateSummary for couchbase, ephemeral and free tier
collection create summary maxTTL -1, empty when unset
7.2.4 blocked, exact 7.6.0 allowed, 7.6.2-build allowed, unknown version allowed
access changes listed per resource line by line
split and merged grants of the same access normalize equal
